## High-Performance Case Studies
* **RAG Document Q&A System**: Secure cloud-native PDF ingestion and RAG AI System. Minimizes query latency dynamically via semantic layout chunking and Qdrant DB vector calculations.
* **AI Chat Gateway**: High-throughput LLM gateway built using Spring Boot. Built custom Token Bucket rate limiter filters and stateless proxy routing. Average routing overhead dropped to under 12ms.
* **VeloLink URL Shortener**: High-performance link redirection engine with collision resolution algorithms and Redis-based cache lookup to route links in sub-5ms.
